- **Gibberella**: Pink/purple mold, starts at tip — no match.
- **Trichoderma**: Dark blue-green mold — no match.
- **Fusarium**: Whitish-pink scattered patches on kernels — no match.
- **Aspergillus**: Olive-green powdery mold at tip — no match.
- **Southern_Corn_Leaf_Blight**: Gray-black felt mold at tip — no match.

The white mycelium growing from the base of the ear is the hallmark of Diplodia Ear Rot, and the visual appearance matches the reference image closely.
